findings.summary: The JSON contract held across all 10 rows with no provider failures.
The model correctly refused contaminated captures for OpenAI and Hermes even when the manifest marked them as usable.
The model produced useful strategist-level reads for Linear, The Verge, Stripe Docs, Headspace, Notion and Le Labo.
Seven of ten rows required Pro adjudication, so the current flow is too expensive and slow for product usage.
Average latency was 21.9s per brand for the adjudicated run.
The current evidence pack underreports capture contamination; the model caught it visually, but deterministic page-state metadata did not.

next_steps: Keep Visual Interpretation Lab isolated from Brand Audit and Scanner.
Run a Flash-only benchmark before allowing Pro adjudication.
Improve capture contamination metadata before more model tuning.
Use Pro only for disputed rows selected by a stricter policy.
Compare recommendation usefulness against human review before promotion.
